transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability claims and the safety anomalies before any major decision.

actions.rationale: We need independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability claims and the safety anomalies before any major decision.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting will give us ground truth on model behavior and reduce reliance on the lab's own potentially conflicted assessments.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits and incident reporting will give us ground truth on model behavior and reduce reliance on the lab's own potentially conflicted assessments.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Congress needs to be briefed and prepared to authorize emergency authorities; this is too large for executive action alone and we need legislative backing for whatever comes next.

actions.rationale: Congress needs to be briefed and prepared to authorize emergency authorities; this is too large for executive action alone and we need legislative backing for whatever comes next.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: Immediately restrict publication and impose security protocols on this model to prevent accidental or intentional leaks while evaluations proceed.

actions.rationale: Immediately restrict publication and impose security protocols on this model to prevent accidental or intentional leaks while evaluations proceed.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip exports now to slow China's acceleration and buy time for our own evaluation and decision-making.

actions.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip exports now to slow China's acceleration and buy time for our own evaluation and decision-making.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
